% Slide-deck prelude.
% Palette, fonts, and listing styles follow the FMCAD'26 deck in
% third_party/move/move-prover/doc/higher-order-paper-26/talk.

\usepackage{xcolor}
% Deck palette: one primary blue, used for title bars, boxes, and keywords.
\definecolor{mBlue}{RGB}{28,73,137}
\definecolor{mNavy}{RGB}{16,42,88}   % full-bleed frames: cover and standout
\definecolor{mRust}{RGB}{176,84,32}  % Rust-side components in diagrams
\definecolor{mRed}{RGB}{190,30,45}   % agreement (semantic equivalence) in diagrams
\colorlet{codebg}{mBlue!9}           % frameless tinted background for listings
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[sfdefault,lining]{FiraSans}
\usepackage[scale=0.85,lining]{FiraMono}
% Code in the medium weight of Fira Mono, so listings hold up against Fira Sans.
\newcommand{\codefont}{\ttfamily\fontseries{medium}\selectfont}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,array}
\usepackage{xspace}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{fontawesome5}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning,shapes.misc,calc,fit,backgrounds}

% Names
\newcommand{\LIR}{\textsf{VIR}\xspace}
\newcommand{\MVP}{\textsf{MVP}\xspace}

% Diagram styles. Rounded boxes are processes, sharp boxes are artifacts;
% blue is Lean (Verex), rust is the Rust code base, grey is external.
\tikzset{
  proc/.style={draw=mBlue, thick, rounded corners=3pt, fill=mBlue!15,
               minimum height=7mm, minimum width=1.9cm, align=center, inner sep=3pt},
  rproc/.style={proc, draw=mRust, fill=mRust!12},
  ext/.style={proc, draw=black!55, fill=black!8},
  art/.style={draw=mBlue, thick, fill=white, minimum height=6mm,
              minimum width=1.6cm, align=center, inner sep=2pt, font=\scriptsize},
  rart/.style={art, draw=mRust},
  arr/.style={-{Latex[length=2mm]}, thick, mNavy},
  rarr/.style={arr, mRust},
  feed/.style={arr, dashed},
  lbl/.style={font=\scriptsize, fill=white, inner sep=1pt},
  group/.style={draw=mBlue, dashed, rounded corners=4pt, inner sep=5pt},
  rgroup/.style={group, draw=mRust},
  gtitle/.style={font=\scriptsize\bfseries, mNavy},
  rgtitle/.style={gtitle, text=mRust},
  swatch/.style={draw=mBlue, thick, minimum height=3mm, minimum width=3mm, inner sep=0pt},
  legend/.style={font=\scriptsize, anchor=west, inner sep=2pt},
}

% Code
\lstdefinestyle{CodeStyle}{
    basicstyle=\codefont,
    keywordstyle=\color{mBlue},
    commentstyle=\color{gray}\normalfont\itshape,
    escapechar=@,
    breaklines=true, upquote=true,
    columns=fullflexible, keepspaces=true,
    literate={<=}{{$\leq$}}2 {>=}{{$\geq$}}2 {!=}{{$\neq$}}2 {==>}{{$\Longrightarrow$}}3,
}

\lstdefinelanguage{Move}{
    morekeywords={
        abort, aborts_if, acquires, address, as, assert, assume, break, const,
        continue, copy, drop, else, ensures, exists, false, forall, friend, fun,
        global, has, if, in, invariant, key, let, loop, match, modifies, module,
        move, mut, native, old, pragma, public, requires, return, spec, store,
        struct, true, u8, u64, u128, u256, use, while},
    sensitive=true,
    morecomment=[l]{//},
    morecomment=[s]{/*}{*/},
}

\lstdefinelanguage{Rust}{
    morekeywords={fn, pub, if, else, let, mut, return, while, loop, match, struct, enum, impl, u8, u32, u64, bool},
    sensitive=true,
    morecomment=[l]{//},
    morecomment=[s]{/*}{*/},
}

\lstdefinelanguage{Lean}{
    morekeywords={
        theorem, def, by, fun, let, have, show, from, at, with, match, do,
        leaner, module, namespace, where, struct, entry, public, spec, verify, requires,
        ensures, aborts_if, modifies, case, exists, global, old, simp, omega},
    sensitive=true,
    morecomment=[l]{--},
}

% Only | as short inline delimiter, without keyword highlighting since it also
% sets commands and paths; frames using it must be fragile.
\lstMakeShortInline[style=CodeStyle]|

% Frameless tinted box around display listings.
\lstdefinestyle{CodeBox}{
    backgroundcolor=\color{codebg},
    frame=single, framerule=0pt, rulecolor=\color{codebg},
    framesep=3pt, xleftmargin=3pt, xrightmargin=3pt,
    aboveskip=\smallskipamount, belowskip=\smallskipamount,
}

\lstnewenvironment{MoveSmall}{
    \lstset{language=Move, style=CodeStyle, style=CodeBox, basicstyle=\scriptsize\codefont}
}{}

\lstnewenvironment{LeanSmall}{
    \lstset{language=Lean, style=CodeStyle, style=CodeBox, basicstyle=\scriptsize\codefont}
}{}

\lstnewenvironment{RustSmall}{
    \lstset{language=Rust, style=CodeStyle, style=CodeBox, basicstyle=\scriptsize\codefont}
}{}

\lstnewenvironment{ShellSmall}{
    \lstset{style=CodeStyle, style=CodeBox, basicstyle=\scriptsize\codefont, keywordstyle=\color{black}}
}{}

% Highlight box for take-aways.
\newcommand{\takeaway}[2][0.9\textwidth]{%
  \par\smallskip
  \centerline{\begin{tikzpicture}
    \node[draw=mBlue, thick, rounded corners, inner sep=5pt,
          text width=#1, fill=mBlue!8]{#2};
  \end{tikzpicture}}\par}
